info.name: B2C Dev — Demo Data Seeder
info.description:
Seeds the demo data for the B2C Developer 2026 course, grouped by session.

The course project already holds the catalogue, prices, channels, and the `bedding-bundle` ProductType, so this seeder only adds what the write sessions need on top:

• **Session 1 — Store context**: languages, countries and distribution/supply channels on `b2c-retail-store` — the sample dataset leaves all three empty.
• **Session 2 — Catalogue**: the Bundles category + the `bedding-bundle` PRODUCT (referencing existing components, no price of its own).
• **Session 4 — Cart**: the bundle link Type + saving discount, the SAVE10 promo, the `monthly` RecurrencePolicy + a Subscribe & Save price, and a pickup channel + inventory.
• **Session 5 — Identity**: the `vip` Customer Group + a group-scoped price, and the demo account `ada@lhc.test` with an existing active cart (running the folder resets her).
• **Session 6 — Orders**: Messages enabled on the Project (for Session 7), the Payment Only Checkout Application `demo-commercetools-checkout-taxes`, and the custom order State machine (the payment connector itself is installed in Merchant Center).
• **Session 7 — Extensibility**: the `order-extras` Custom Type, the `lhc-config/feature-flags` Custom Object, keys on the demo products' variants and prices, and the `lhc-price-feed` ImportContainer.

• **Session 9 — Connect**: the three connector repositories (`ecoliving-order-connectors`, `ecoliving-price-feed-connector`, `ecoliving-customer-connectors`) registered as ConnectorStaged drafts at their release tag, with the preview requested (needs `manage_connectors`; the installation itself stays in Merchant Center).
• **Verify — customer connector**: after installing `ecoliving-customer-connectors`, signs up a test customer and checks all three apps end to end (number, outbox mail, receiver confirm).

Run order: **0 — Authorization** first, then the folder for the session you're about to teach. Every folder is idempotent (tolerates 409 / DuplicatePriceScope), so it is safe to re-run.

The bundle uses one pattern — a reference-attribute bundle with roll-up pricing (FA decisions D7 · D37 · D38). Single-SKU kits, buy-together promos, and free kits / GWP (`giftLineItem`) are left for T2 to explore as design transfer.

item.name: Session 1 — Store context
item.description:
Run FIRST, before Session 1, on every fresh cohort project.

Configures `b2c-retail-store` with languages ['en-US', 'en-GB', 'de-DE'], countries ['DE', 'GB', 'US'], distribution channel `distribution-channel` and supply channel `inventory-channel`. The sample dataset creates the Store and the Channels but never connects them, so without this the Store's `languages`, `countries` and `distributionChannels` are all empty.

That matters immediately: task 1.4 (`GET /api/store-context`) reads those three fields, and the storefront's language picker, country switch and channel bar are driven by them. It matters again in Sessions 2-3, where price selection is scoped by store -> channel + country + currency.

A Channel can only go in the list its roles allow — `distributionChannels` needs `ProductDistribution`, `supplyChannels` needs `InventorySupply`; the wrong list is a 400 `MissingRoleOnChannel`. `pickup-store` is InventorySupply, so the Session 4 folder creates it and attaches it there.

All four are `set*` actions, so the folder converges: re-running it changes nothing rather than appending duplicates.

Session 2 — Catalogue (bundle on the PDP)
item.description:

Components are single-master-variant on purpose: `product-ref` is a Set<Reference<Product>> and cannot pin a variant, so the roll-up uses each component's master variant. A component WITH variants is the D7 'reference = product, not variant' nuance — the T2 stretch is SKU-pinned references.

Also adds the bundle, its components and `charlie-armchair` to the store's product selection (when `b2c-retail-store` has one) — a store cart can only hold products its selection contains.

item.name: Session 4 — Cart (bundle · promo · subscription · fulfilment & stock)
item.description:
Run before the cart session. Four subfolders seed everything the S4 write tasks need beyond the catalogue:

• **Bundle (4.3)** — the `bundle-line` line-item Custom Type (`bundleId`/`parentId`) and the `bundle-saving` Cart Discount (reuses the `bedding-bundle` product from the Session 2 folder).
• **Promo — SAVE10 (4.9)** — the `save10` Cart Discount + the `SAVE10` Discount Code (10% off carts over €100).
• **Subscription — monthly (4.4)** — the `monthly` RecurrencePolicy (required, or a recurring add returns 400) + a recurrence-scoped Subscribe & Save price (10% off) on `charlie-armchair`.
• **Fulfilment & stock (4.5 / 4.6)** — a `pickup-store` supply channel and InventoryEntries for `CARM-023` (100 on delivery, 3 on pickup).

Idempotent: re-running tolerates 409 (already exists) and DuplicatePriceScope (the recurrence price is already present).

Session 5 — Identity (vip group & price · demo account with a cart)
item.description:
Run before the identity session. Three subfolders:

• **Customer group & VIP price (5.6)** — the `vip` Customer Group + a group-scoped price (€399 vs €499 list) on `charlie-armchair`, so the PLP re-prices when a VIP signs in.
• **Reset Ada** — deletes `ada-active-cart` and `ada-lhc` if present (404-tolerant), so running the whole folder always yields a fresh demo account.
• **Demo account** — `ada@lhc.test` / `Lhc-demo-2026!` (global, ungrouped) WITH an existing active cart (1× CARM-023 + 1× LPC-011). Without that cart the two merge modes look identical.

Demo script: as a guest add 2× CARM-023, sign in as Ada with `mergeMode=MergeWithExistingCustomerCart` → CARM-023 merges (qty 2, higher wins), LPC-011 survives; then `PUT /api/customers/me/group {"customerGroupKey":"vip"}` → the PLP shows €399.

Idempotent: creates tolerate 409 / 400 DuplicateField; the VIP price tolerates DuplicatePriceScope; the reset tolerates 404.

Session 6 — Orders (Messages on · Checkout application · order State machine)
item.description:
Run before the checkout session. **Enables Messages** on the Project (Session 7's timeline + consumer read the S6 orders' history — and Messages are not retroactive), **configures the shipped `demo-commercetools-checkout-taxes` Checkout Application** (payment return URL → the storefront's confirmation page, all origins allowed for test, countries DE/US/GB), and seeds the custom **order State machine** the 6.7 task drives: `order-placed` (initial) → `order-picked` → `order-shipped` → `order-delivered`, plus `order-cancelled` reachable only from `order-placed`. Idempotent.

**Not seedable — the trainer does this once in Merchant Center:** (1) Connect marketplace → install *Sample payment connector for checkout*; (2) on the `demo-commercetools-checkout-taxes` application → Payment integrations → add the Sample connector (Card, and Invoice if you want a second method), activate it; (3) on that integration switch **Automated Reversal** on with the predicate `1 = 1`, or 6.5's OutOfStock demo leaves the shopper's money authorized; (4) the BFF's API client needs `manage_sessions` + `manage_checkout_payment_intents`. Test card: Visa 4111 1111 1111 1111.

Reuses S4's `pickup-store` (3 × CARM-023 → OutOfStock at the commit), the `monthly` policy + Subscribe & Save price (the Recurring Order), and S5's `ada@lhc.test`.

item.name: Order State machine (6.7)
item.description: Five OrderState States with guarded transitions: order-placed (initial) → order-picked → order-shipped → order-delivered; order-cancelled only from order-placed. Created leaf-first so transitions resolve by key.

item.name: Session 7 — Extensibility (order-extras Type · feature flags · price keys · import container)
item.description:
Run before the extensibility session. Seeds the **`order-extras` Custom Type** on `order` (giftMessage · requiresWhiteGlove · owner — 7.1 / 7.6 / 7.7), the **`lhc-config/feature-flags`** Custom Object with its defaults (7.2), **keys on the demo products' variants and prices** so the Import API can update them by key (7.8), and the **`lhc-price-feed` ImportContainer** on the Import API host (7.8). Idempotent.

**Also needed, per laptop (not seedable):** a public URL for the BFF — `cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:8081` — exported as EXTENSION_PUBLIC_URL, plus an EXTENSION_SECRET, then restart the BFF (7.6 / 7.7). **Messages** must already be on: the Session 6 folder enables them (not retroactive — S7's timeline and consumer read the S6 orders' history).

**Not needed:** any cloud account or message queue — Subscriptions are taught as a concept; Session 8's Connect Event app provisions the queue.

item.name: Custom Type — order-extras (7.1 / 7.6 / 7.7)
item.description: One Type on `order` resources (covers carts AND orders — the cart's fields snapshot onto the Order): `giftMessage` (7.1), `requiresWhiteGlove` (set by the 7.7 Extension), `owner` (the participant key the cart module stamps and the 7.6 conditional trigger keys on). Duplicate key is tolerated.

item.name: Session 9 — Connect (ConnectorStaged drafts for the three EcoLiving connectors)
item.description:
Registers the three course connector repositories with Connect as ConnectorStaged (drafts) and requests their preview status, so Session 9 starts at the deployment step.

• Needs `manage_connectors` on the API client ({{client_id}}) — Connect scopes are NOT part of manage_project; add it (and `manage_connectors_deployments` + `manage_api_clients` for the deployment) and re-run `0 — Authorization`.
• `connect_host` = https://connect.<region>.commercetools.com; `connect_region` = the project's region (e.g. europe-west1.gcp) — used for privateProjects and supportedRegions.
• The repositories are public, so no GitHub access grant is needed (a private repo would need read access for the connect-mu machine user).
• The DEPLOYMENT (installation) is not seeded: it needs the apps' secured configuration (API client secret) and is done in Merchant Center — Manage connectors -> the connector -> Deploy on Preview — or with `commercetools connect deployment create`.

Re-run safe: an existing draft answers 400/409 and is reported as OK; updatePreviewable on an already-previewable draft is tolerated.

item.name: ecoliving-order-connectors (cart-rules Service + order-events Event app)
item.description: Session 8/9 — the Session-7 handlers as a connector. Creates the ConnectorStaged from the public GitHub repository at the tag in {{order_flow_tag}} (Connect deploys a TAG, not a branch; the tag must pass `commercetools connect validate`), then requests the preview. Preview validation runs on commercetools' side and can take a few minutes — re-run the last GET until previewable=true (the log line shows previewableStatusInfo while it is pending or failed).

item.name: Verify — customer connector (after installing ecoliving-customer-connectors)
item.description:
End-to-end check of the three customer-connector apps on the project the connector is installed on:

1. Sign up a throwaway customer → the **customer-number-generator** Extension sets `EL-000123`.
2. Read `ecoliving-mail-outbox/<customerId>` → the **email-verification-sender** (Subscription on CustomerCreated) created the token and 'sent' the link.
3. Call the **email-verification-receiver** as the mail's link would → 302 to `/verify-email?status=ok`.
4. The customer's `isEmailVerified` is true. 5. The same link again → `status=invalid`.

**Set first:** `customer_receiver_url` = the receiver's URL from the deployment log, ending in `/email-verification-confirm`. Messages must be enabled on the project (Session 6 folder). The sandbox sleeps when idle: if step 1 has no number or step 2 answers 404, wait a few seconds and re-send. Each run creates a new `connector-check-…@lhc.test` customer; delete them afterwards if you like.
